questions.title: Integer Division
questions.question: What is the output of `printf("%d", 7 / 2);`?
questions.solution: Both operands are integers, so integer division discards the fractional part. The result is 3.

questions.title: Multiple Correct Options
questions.question: Which of the following are relational operators in C?
questions.solution: ==, <= and != are relational/equality operators. && is a logical AND operator.

questions.title: Numerical Answer
questions.question: Evaluate the expression: 17 % 5
questions.solution: The remainder when 17 is divided by 5 is 2.
